title: Recursive Self-Improvement via .cgp Cognitive Patches
description: Research framework and protocol for recursive self-improvement (RSI) of language models using CognitiveOS .cgp Cognitive Patches and the cpm toolchain. This release contains the framework, deterministic verifier, zero-trust promotion gate, pre-registered protocol, and an arXiv-ready paper. Empirical M0-M6 results are pending GPU execution and are explicitly not claimed.
notes: Framework-only release. Empirical M0-M6 results are not included; see RSI_CGP_PROOF.md section 5.1 (executed checks) versus section 5.2 (pre-registered, pending GPU).
